settings.hero_desc: Bold geometric sculptures in clean forms and vivid solid colours - pyramids, spheres, molecular clusters and more - made to your shape, scale and palette. Striking statement art for lobbies, showrooms, studios and modern interiors.
settings.s1_body: Clean geometry in confident colour makes some of the most effective modern art there is. We design and build bold geometric sculptures - from a crisp pyramid to a molecular sphere cluster or a sculptural hourglass - in the form, scale and palette your space calls for. Each piece becomes an instant focal point for a lobby, showroom or interior.
settings.case_body: Produced as a series of geometric statement pieces, these sculptures give interiors an immediate point of focus - bold shapes in confident colour, scaled and finished to suit each space and brand.
settings.case_quote: Such a simple shape, but it completely transforms the room. Everyone comments on it.
settings.prov_p: There is a reason designers reach for clean geometry and bold colour - it reads instantly and never dates. Scaled up as sculpture, simple shapes become powerful, memorable art.
